m24.note: fallback for l8 (Llama-3.1-8B gated); multimodal checkpoint, needs a dedicated serving path. W99p: served text-only from src_path = the language_model.* tensors of the pinned HF shards, byte-identical, renamed to MistralForCausalLM (scripts/a6000/m24_textonly.py; provenance and file sha256 in src_path/textonly.json), official tekken.json tokenizer with vLLM --tokenizer-mode mistral and --tool-call-parser mistral; local prompt rendering via cloq/mistral_render.py. The Pixtral/Mistral3 vLLM classes cannot be imported with transformers 5.17 (a6k2_smoke_m24 failure).
m24.fork_gpus_per_role_note: W99p: 24B BF16 (47 GB) does not fit one A6000, so B and Q are each TP=2 on an NVLink pair (fork tasks: gpus 4, gpus_per_role 2)

l8.note: second family; official meta repo (safetensors sha256 identical to the unsloth mirror used for a6k2_smoke_l8, checked 2026-09-28). tools_in_user_message=false: tau2's first non-system turn is the agent greeting, which the default template (tools in first user message) re-labels as a user turn carrying the tool list (W9)
l8.ext_request_note: W99f: ext adapters only (scripts/ext/common.py gen_params); the Llama-3.1 template raises on an assistant turn with >1 tool call, so BFCL requests ask vLLM to keep the first call only. tau2 runs do not read this field.
